Official stat semantics: SPE (top speed; falls with ENERGY; dribbling loss inversely proportional to CON), ACC, STA (depletion rate + half-time boost; position-dependent), CON (dribble speed loss, kick-after-touch speed, touch proximity, skill kicks/controls/shots/moves), STR (collision impact, stumble duration), TAC (tackle success; standing/sliding distances), PAS (all pass accuracy), SHO (accuracy, 'assist' away from keeper, shot height, skill shots with CON, special kicks/headers, free-kick spin), GKH (catch vs deflect, claiming crosses, stability in contact), GKR (reaction time, save chance vs shot speed/distance, anticipate saves), ENERGY (fatigue; below threshold all stats gradually reduce). FTG framing: game not a simulation; unpredictability inherent

Prize Ladder awards items on progression (like Season Pass): coins, gems, coaches, Dream Point Boosts, special players, more. Dream Points given in matches; more earned = more rewards unlocked. Dream Point Boosts purchasable within the Prize Ladder

Season Pass (from v12.200+): FREE and SEASON PASS tiers; Progress Bank pays currency from DLL XP at season end; gold profile elements; not a subscription, repurchased each season; Season Points from matches (amount varies by mode); mid-season purchase unlocks already-reached premium tiers; tier locks correspond to days; premium removes all tier locks

Clan rules: one clan at a time; single leader (succession; empty clan disappears); entry requirements (hidden from search unless met; invite codes work); Clan Points from matches, challenges, season passes; FTG may remove players/clans breaching Terms of Use; disputes not mediated

Single-player difficulty starts easy and scales with division movement (up and down); base difficulty Medium/Hard option since DLS25. DLL: always real users, NO bots, NO difficulty control, NO manipulation of any in-game situation including teammate AI, NO influencing of outcomes. Fair-gaming commitment: ftgames.com/core-principles

Dream Point Boosts: purchased within the Prize Ladder; temporarily increase Dream Points per match; apply to career, dream draft, scenario and DLL matches ONLY (not exhibition/friend); unusable when the Prize Ladder is complete/inactive; unused boosts carry to the next ladder; live-service subject to change

Four recruitment routes: Transfers (new players appear each in-game week = after playing a single-player match), Scouts (selection at discounted rate), Agents (immediately add a player), Prize Ladder (special rare players on criteria)
Gems from: league objectives, tournaments, Season Pass, Prize Ladder, Multiplayer (Dream League Live); quantity varies by circumstance; purchasable in shop
FTG provides no release schedules or planned-activity indications; official news via TikTok @dreamleaguesoccer.ftg, Instagram playdls, Facebook dreamleaguesoccer

entries.payload_summary: FTG article 360003914778 'How do I develop my players?' found (coaches randomly select a player for permanent upgrade; Form Boost = temporary upgrade, duration by Training facilities level); Reddit coaching threads (Fitness = SPE/ACC/STA/STR, Technical = CON/PAS/SHO/TAC; Common +1 / Rare +2 / Legendary +3; GK coaches; Special coaches offer 2 randomized choices; max = base+10, rarely +11); bluestacks; sakibpro simulator (weighted progression energy - Speculative); levelwinner

Coaches (Team Management screen) randomly select a player for a PERMANENT upgrade; Form Boost = more powerful but TEMPORARY upgrade lasting a set number of matches, duration scaled by Training facilities level (min one match). Related: players missing (213852049), can I sell players (360003945617), how do I sell players (1714655181585)

Coin sources: winning matches, drawing matches, clean sheets, scoring goals, stadium bonuses, season objectives, Season Pass rewards, Prize Ladder rewards, final league positions, cup wins, watching video clips (where available)
Free coins: watch short video clips, subject to availability

One DLS account per player. Manage Devices + Link Profile under Options (gear, top left) > Advanced. Transfer via Sign in with Google (Android only) / Sign in with Apple (iOS only); cross-platform via generated code (Generate Code on old device, Link Profile on new; code unusable on the generating device); linked devices listed/removable; signing out of Google/Apple unlinks the profile - loss-susceptible on uninstall/change; codes and details unrecoverable if lost; never share

Ban policy: modded APKs, external software hacks on authorised versions, and exploitation of unknown bugs are targeted (inappropriate virtual-currency gain, gameplay-AI interference, circumvention of normal progression, other extraneous activity); particularly crucial in DLL (fair-means expectation); the ONLY authorised versions are from Apple's App Store or Google's Play Store - no other versions supported; extreme-circumstance action on offensive team/manager names; support will NOT remove bans on request unless incorrectly flagged; Terms: ftgames.com/terms-of-use

Leaderboards compare performance against other players in Dream League Live; reset at regular intervals (from 3-30 days); prizes awarded by position at the end time. Corrects the community 'weekly' instance (REVISION R-001)

Friend Match: private match via a shared code or word (A-Z, 0-9, hyphen only); found under the Dream League Live (Multiplayer) button; Friend Match stats tracked there. User comments: no rewards when the opponent quits; connect failures after code entry; opponent team name not visible

Reset Profile button (skull and crossbones) under Settings (gear, top left) > Advanced. IRREVERSIBLE: all progress lost including coins, gems, consumables and in-app purchases; cannot be undone; limited to one reset every 30 days. Registered as IRREV-001

Online required for the majority of features (security; reduces unfair exploits); all progress backed up on FTG servers, restorable across devices; some sections accessible offline; Exhibition matches playable offline

iOS: compatible with most devices; check App Store for minimum OS version (varies per app). Android: 3,000+ devices supported; availability restricted by device hardware, carrier restrictions, territory legislation; minimum Android OS varies per app - check Google Play
